name: Lipoid Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for Lipoid CAH

criteria.description: Impaired steroid hormone synthesis due to mutations in the STAR gene
Early onset adrenal insufficiency with salt-wasting crisis in neonates
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the STAR gene
Low plasma cortisol and aldosterone with elevated ACTH and renin levels
Enlarged adrenal glands with lipid accumulation on imaging

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical adrenal insufficiency with salt-wasting crisis plus genetic confirmation of STAR mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by genetic testing; biochemical and imaging findings support diagnosis.

pathognomonic.notes: Life-threatening hyponatremia and hyperkalemia in early infancy
Markedly low serum cortisol levels leading to adrenal insufficiency

pathognomonic.symptomName: 46,XY sex reversal with female external genitalia
pathognomonic.notes: Phenotypic females despite XY karyotype due to impaired androgen synthesis

common.symptomName: Hyperpigmentation of skin and mucous membranes

common.notes: Poor weight gain and growth delay in infancy
Resulting from salt-wasting and adrenal insufficiency
Low sodium levels due to aldosterone deficiency
Elevated potassium levels due to mineralocorticoid deficiency

occasional.notes: Low blood glucose due to cortisol deficiency
Detected on imaging due to lipid accumulation

rare.notes: Rare complication due to fragile adrenal tissue
Due to severe hypoglycemia or electrolyte disturbances

laboratory: Elevated plasma ACTH and renin activity
imaging: Bilateral adrenal gland enlargement with lipid accumulation on ultrasound or CT
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in the STAR gene
other: Elevated plasma 17-hydroxyprogesterone is typically low or normal (distinguishing from other CAH forms)

distinguishingFeatures: Less severe salt-wasting in some cases
Hypertension and hypokalemia instead of salt-wasting
Sexual infantilism with lack of secondary sexual characteristics

redFlags: Neonatal salt-wasting crisis with dehydration and shock
references: Miller WL. Lipoid congenital adrenal hyperplasia. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2018;103(3):784-792.
Lin D, Sugawara T, Strauss JF 3rd. Molecular biology of the steroidogenic acute regulatory protein, StAR. Mol Cell Endocrinol. 1995;115(1):1-7.
